title: Report Dates, Publication Dates, and the A-Share ROE Signal: A Pre-Specified Historical Confirmation
target_journal_route: Pacific-Basin Finance Journal hybrid pre-registration pathway
research_question: In a single-version provider snapshot, how much of the measured A-share ROE-return relation remains when the accounting signal is withheld until the first common official signal session strictly after its recorded publication date?

pilot_evidence.role: disclosed empirical precondition only; excluded from claims of prospective confirmation

lock_conditions.per_symbol_quote_contract: At every one of the 156 first-official-session rebalances, at least 1,000 strict SH/SZ A-share identifiers must jointly have quote rows at every t-60 through t session; every t-20 through t session; every t-19 through t session; and t, t+1, t+20, and t+21. This is an outcome-free identifier/date-presence gate; monthly aggregates and file endpoints are insufficient.
lock_conditions.failure_rule: If a minimum gate fails, stop and report the failed gate; do not shorten the sample, substitute a later interval, or relax a threshold after inspecting factor outcomes.

post_execution_evidence_eligibility.signal_eligible_denominator_rule: Determine the factor-variant signal-eligible set before consulting outcome availability. Every member of that denominator must receive an endpoint-resolution reason code; outcome availability may not silently shrink the denominator.
post_execution_evidence_eligibility.endpoint_integrity_rule: The result receipt must contain aggregate endpoint-resolution counts, the SHA-256 of the complete per-security endpoint-reason ledger, and an integrity assertion that the ledger covers every signal-eligible security-month-factor-variant record.
post_execution_evidence_eligibility.timing: Evaluate only after externally authorized execution; this is an evidence-status stop rule, not a pre-lock coverage test or permission for the analysis team to inspect outcomes.
post_execution_evidence_eligibility.failure_rule: Any unresolved required endpoint makes the affected cell non-estimable and the study reports INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE without shortening the interval, dropping securities or registered cells, or changing thresholds.

target_sample.market: Shanghai and Shenzhen A-shares; Beijing Stock Exchange is outside the current data boundary
target_sample.confirmatory_boundary: The 2010-2022 historical panel is the intended previously uninspected primary sample and requires an owner exposure attestation before lock; the disclosed January 2025-June 2026 pilot evaluation (using a source quote file that begins in 2023) is excluded from primary inference.
target_sample.rebalance_session: first eligible exchange session of each month
target_sample.prospective_extension: At least 12 months collected after external registration or in-principle acceptance, reported separately from both the historical panel and the disclosed pilot.

items.momentum_12_1: cumulative return from month t-12 through t-2
items.low_vol_60d: negative standard deviation of daily returns over 60 sessions
items.roe_reconstructed: trailing net income divided by average common equity when point-in-time statement fields permit

primary_estimands.definition: paired monthly mean IC difference I0000_pit_publication minus A1_pit_report_end for ROE
primary_estimands.reported_test: two-sided H0: mean monthly difference equals zero
primary_estimands.interpretation_rule: Call the result timing inflation or attenuation only when the report-period comparator IC is positive and the signed difference is negative; otherwise describe it neutrally as timing displacement.

secondary_estimands: paired composite IC difference I0000_pit_publication minus A1_pit_report_end as a downstream, mechanically ROE-dependent result
paired IC difference A1_pit_report_end minus A0_final_report_end
paired IC difference I1111_full_implementation minus I0000_pit_publication
Shapley contribution of each implementation component to the full IC implementation effect
ROE report-side support-restriction component in the ordered common-support decomposition
ROE within-common-support record-replacement component in the ordered common-support decomposition
ROE publication-side support-extension component in the ordered common-support decomposition
momentum and low-volatility publication-timing contrasts as deterministic negative controls outside the inferential family

roe_timing_common_support_decomposition.scope: ROE publication-timing primary contrast only; no analogous decomposition is registered for the composite or implementation block

sets.report_support_R_t: Signal-eligible securities with finite report-period ROE under A1 after all non-outcome eligibility rules; every required endpoint must already be resolved under the endpoint contract.
sets.publication_support_P_t: Signal-eligible securities with finite recorded-publication-date ROE under I0000 after all non-outcome eligibility rules; every required endpoint must already be resolved under the endpoint contract.
sets.common_support_C_t: Intersection R_t and P_t; neither nesting direction is assumed.

roe_timing_common_support_decomposition.statistic: IC_R(S) and IC_P(S) recompute both ROE and outcome ranks within the indicated set S before calculating rank IC.
roe_timing_common_support_decomposition.monthly_identity: IC_P(P_t) minus IC_R(R_t) equals the sum of the three ordered components in every estimable month.
roe_timing_common_support_decomposition.failure_rule: A non-finite bridge IC or identity residual above the registered efficiency tolerance invalidates the run; do not force support nesting, impute a bridge value, or drop a security to make the identity hold.
roe_timing_common_support_decomposition.interpretation_boundary: This is an ordered arithmetic decomposition for potentially non-nested supports. The components are not causal effects, and record replacement is not a revision or vintage effect.

items: report-side finite-signal count, publication-side finite-signal count, common-support count, report-only count, and publication-only count by month
share of report-side selected records whose recorded publishDate is on or after the signal date
share of common-support securities for which the selected reportPeriodEnd differs between the report-period and recorded-publication-date rules
distribution of calendar days from reportPeriodEnd to recorded publishDate, reported without association to returns
publication_exposure_diagnostics.inference: descriptive only; no p-values, no BH membership, no return interaction, and no event-study interpretation

roe_definition.primary_field: provider roeDiluted normalized to decimal units and mapped to roe
roe_definition.frequency_rule: Use the latest reported cumulative interim or annual observation without analyst annualization; report-period frequency remains as supplied and is disclosed by quarter.
roe_definition.duplicate_rule: Fail closed on duplicate symbol-reportPeriodEnd records unless a separately validated vintage schema identifies versions.
roe_definition.lock_gate: The provider field dictionary, formula, units, and endpoint mapping must be hash-bound before registration; otherwise the plan cannot lock.

outcome_clocks.ic_no_lag: Signal at exchange close t; adjusted close-to-close return from t to t+20 official exchange sessions.
outcome_clocks.ic_one_session_lag: Same signal definition; adjusted close-to-close return from t+1 to t+21 official exchange sessions.
outcome_clocks.portfolio_baseline_planned: Signal after close t; unadjusted-open entry at t+1 and exit at t+21.
outcome_clocks.portfolio_lag_planned: Signal after close t; unadjusted-open entry at t+2 and exit at t+22.
outcome_clocks.publication_date_rule: A date-only publishDate becomes usable strictly after that date, never on the same exchange session.
outcome_clocks.current_endpoint_adapter: exact adjusted-close quote on each required official endpoint only
outcome_clocks.unresolved_endpoint_rule: Do not advance to the next quote, carry forward a last price, or assign a default recovery. Mark the cell non-estimable and the study INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

endpoint_resolution_contract.denominator: The signal-eligible security set is fixed before outcome availability is examined.
endpoint_resolution_contract.reason_code_rule: Every signal-eligible record receives a machine-readable endpoint code. Any code other than EXACT_OFFICIAL_SESSION_ADJUSTED_CLOSE is unresolved under the current core and makes that cell non-estimable.
endpoint_resolution_contract.receipt_rule: The canonical result receipt reports aggregate code counts, binds the complete private per-security endpoint-reason ledger by SHA-256, and verifies exact denominator coverage without redistributing licensed rows.

official_calendar_contract.format: UTF-8 CSV with one header named date and one unique common SSE/SZSE official open session per row
official_calendar_contract.session_definition: Each row is a common session on which both SSE and SZSE are officially open; any exchange disagreement fails closed until resolved from authoritative provenance
official_calendar_contract.hash_rule: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 CSV bytes; no line-ending or row normalization after freeze

portfolio_protocol.boundary: No portfolio sort, weighting, entry, exit, nonfill, delisting, terminal-wealth, cost, or turnover rule is authorized by this protocol.
portfolio_protocol.future_requirement: Any portfolio module requires complete execution and terminal-event data, implementation and tests, its own estimand and missingness contract, and a separate external freeze before outcome access.

inference.unit: monthly cross-section for the current IC core
inference.primary_test: paired monthly variant difference with Newey-West HAC lag 3 and 95% confidence interval
inference.primary_directional_prediction: mean monthly difference less than zero
inference.reported_null_hypothesis: two-sided H0: mean monthly difference equals zero
inference.secondary_check: Stationary block bootstrap is a planned, unimplemented module and is excluded from the current registered IC core.
inference.primary_family_correction: No multiplicity adjustment because ROE publication-timing signed decrement is the sole primary estimand; report a two-sided p-value and 95% confidence interval.
inference.secondary_family_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery rate 0.10 across one downstream composite publication contrast, eight paired IC contrasts, sixteen component-factor Shapley IC estimates, and three ordered ROE common-support components (28 fixed members, including non-estimable members as non-rejections); later portfolio or event-study families require a separate locked plan.
inference.common_support_secondary_members: The three non-directional ROE ordered common-support components join the composite, paired, and Shapley secondaries; all 28 secondary p-values enter one Benjamini-Hochberg family at FDR 0.10.
inference.small_sample_rule: If fewer than 120 paired monthly observations remain for an estimand, report its estimate and interval but make no significance or generalization claim; evidentiary status still requires all 156 target rebalances.
inference.shapley_rule: Compute exact four-component Shapley values from all 16 pre-specified implementation combinations; order-invariance applies only within this four-component implementation block.
inference.precision_design: At 156 months, a normal-approximation 80% power sensitivity with monthly paired standard deviation 0.08-0.12 and HAC variance inflation 1.0-1.5 implies an absolute IC minimum detectable effect of approximately 0.018-0.033. No Stage-2 outcome may be used to revise this threshold.

current_ic_core_outputs: exact four-component IC Shapley allocation preserving interactions
three-part ordered ROE common-support decomposition with a deterministic efficiency check
publication-exposure diagnostics that use no forward returns
per-security endpoint-resolution reason ledger bound by hash plus aggregate receipt counts

items: full per-security signal-missingness and non-endpoint exclusion audit beyond the registered aggregate counts
eligible-universe-loss attribution beyond the registered report/common/publication support counts
structured deviation log and receipt reporting
planned_excluded_modules.promotion_rule: No listed item may enter a registered claim unless its code, tests, data gates, exact estimands, numerical settings, and multiplicity treatment are completed and frozen before Stage-2 outcome access.

items: Main Board, ChiNext, and STAR Market where coverage permits
state-owned versus non-state-owned firms when an independently sourced ownership field is available
alternative literature-standard momentum and volatility windows
second-vendor field-level audit on a pre-specified random sample when legally available

sequence: externally timestamp coverage_probe_spec.v2.json before executing its bounded outcome-blind probe
freeze the v2 probe receipt, outcome-blind gates, official calendar, prior inventory, prior-exposure attestation, code, and execution-plan core
create design_manifest_v1 binding the exact frozen core and input hashes without self-reference or later artifacts
externally timestamp the exact design-manifest bytes or SHA-256 digest
record registration_receipt_v1 binding that manifest digest and verify provider evidence
create execution_authorization binding the manifest, receipt, plan core, official calendar, and gates before blind-data release
populate the final execution-plan external_registration envelope and locked_at with backward-pointing hashes and the authorization timestamp without changing the registered plan core
registration_contract.non_circularity_rule: The canonical registered plan-core digest excludes only external_registration and locked_at. The design manifest cannot contain its own digest, the registration receipt, or execution authorization. The receipt points only backward to the manifest. The authorization points only backward to the manifest, receipt, and frozen design inputs. The later execution-plan envelope records those backward-pointing hashes but cannot alter the registered core.
registration_contract.verification_trust_boundary: The current runner accepts only a retained provider record checked by a named human verifier. It does not implement cryptographic signature or inclusion-proof validation; a future cryptographic path requires a separately implemented and tested protocol.

reporting_rule: Report every registered IC factor-variant cell, exactly 29 inferential estimands (the sole primary plus the fixed 28-member secondary family), the three ordered ROE common-support components, their deterministic efficiency check at absolute tolerance 1e-12, the two deterministic timing-isolation checks, aggregate signal-missingness/common-support counts, and the no-return publication-exposure diagnostics; do not select or headline a best strategy. Cell-level means, Newey-West t-statistics, and top-minus-universe spreads are descriptive completeness outputs only and cannot support cell-specific discovery claims. The result receipt must bind the complete per-security endpoint-reason ledger and verify coverage of the signal-eligible denominator. Percentage attenuation, raw-ratio, robustness, structured deviation-log reporting, portfolio, cost, interaction-test, bootstrap, turnover, nonfill, and announcement-event outputs remain unavailable and excluded until their separately frozen modules exist.

claim_gates.single_version_boundary: The strongest authorized accounting-timing statement is a recorded-publication-date specification effect in a single-version provider snapshot. It does not identify the value investors observed at first release, subsequent revisions, or an announcement-return reaction.
claim_gates.promotion_rule: A claim may change only in a new receipt schema after all corresponding pre-specified evidence gates pass.
